answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind every identity to a refundable attestation bond plus a unique signing key. Each agent must sign its outputs with that key, so one human running a thousand fake accounts still needs a thousand separate bonds: attack cost scales linearly, and colluding or misbehaving keys get slashed. Picture a mirror that reveals duplicate shared origins, a quill that refuses to write without its own key, and each genuine agent standing on its own funded island, unable to copy a neighbour stake.
